questions.answer: 5 days before school start I was choosing my topics, which was a bit stressfull, and at that time it was still unsure if i would get the courses. When i arrived I had to go to an office to get my week schedule, and change courses, to make it all fit, because I had 10 courses (ECTS each) which is a very different systemt compared to my home university. So very stressfull and confusing system.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: The cinemas is so great in Paris. They are old and beautiful and show great oldschool movies. The parcs are great too! If you live in the Cité universitaire in Paris, then there are a lot of awesome sport facilities!

questions.answer: The course schedule and process is great stressfull, and it feels stupid having 10 courses, but its just how it is, and i will be fun too.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Learning the language and getting new friends

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The amount of school work. 20 hours each week, a midterm exam in each, a presentation in each and a final exam in each as well. And all the exams are in hand with pen and paper
